data.title: 芙兰达 · 雨天屋檐下的飞扑搂颈索吻
data.description: 暴雨如注的街巷屋檐下，浑身微湿的芙兰达一把丢掉雨伞扑入你的怀里，双手死死搂住你的脖子。贝雷帽微歪，金发少女眼角含泪、带着急促的喘息大喊：“结果……要是你敢离开我，我就用炸弹把你炸上天！”
data.location: rainy city alleyway under narrow shop eaves
data.action: leaping forward into partner embrace in the pouring rain, clinging around his neck with wet blonde hair and tearful desperate blue eyes
data.lighting: cool rainy dusk lights mingled with neon shop reflections
data.mood: emotional catharsis, desperate possessive affection, dramatic rain confession
data.promptProse: Under rainy shop eaves, blonde Frenda Seivelun leaps into partner arms, clinging around his neck with wet hair and tearful passionate blue eyes.
data.animaCaption: Frenda Seivelun leaping into partner arms under rain eaves.
